title: M5 stage21: quotient congruence preserves exact complete signature
scope: Section 5 exact signature bridge for packed and repaired supports. No root decomposition or squarefree assumptions.

spec.name: M5.SignatureCongruence.divisibility_of_quotient_eq
spec.statement: ∀ (D a a' : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T : ℕ), D ∣ M5.cyclicModulus T → AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a' → (D ∣ a ↔ D ∣ a')
spec.guidance: Use quotient equality to show cyclicModulus T divides a-a' via map_sub and AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero. Then D divides the difference, so divisibility is equivalent. Do not assume T positive: ideal/kernel argument holds even when cyclicModulus 0 is zero. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.SignatureCongruence.complete_signature_congruence
spec.statement: ∀ (a b a' b' : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T : ℕ), AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a' → AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) b = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) b' → M5.completeSignature a b T = M5.completeSignature a' b' T
spec.guidance: Apply accepted M5.Signature.binary_dvd_antisymm to the two complete signatures. Unfold completeSignature and use EuclideanDomain.dvd_gcd_iff together with divisibility_of_quotient_eq. Preserve full polynomial multiplicities and allow zero polynomials. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.SignatureCongruence.packed_complete_signature
spec.statement: ∀ (w T : ℕ) (r s : Fin w → Fin T), M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (M5.Packing.packedSupport r)) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (M5.Packing.packedSupport s)) T = M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple r) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofResidueTuple s) T
spec.guidance: Apply complete_signature_congruence and accepted M5.SupportPolynomial.packed_polynomial_residue in each block. This is the literal occurrence packing, with repeated residues and all cancellations retained. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.SignatureCongruence.repaired_complete_signature
spec.statement: ∀ (A B : Finset ℕ) (e k T : ℕ), e ∈ A → e + k * T ∉ A → M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (M5.RepairSupport.repaired A e (e + k * T))) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B) T = M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A) (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport B) T
spec.guidance: Apply complete_signature_congruence using accepted M5.RepairSupport.replacement_polynomial_residue for the first block and reflexivity for the second block. Positivity, anchoring, and connectivity are separate physical obligations; do not add them to this algebraic signature identity. Return tactic lines without a leading by; preserve exact target.
